# Groundswell Energy — Senior Data Engineer Sourcing

## 1. Prioritised contact list

| Priority | Candidate | Fit vs must-haves: 5+ yrs, Spark/Flink, Kafka, Airflow+, prod. streaming | Risks / Open questions | Decision | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Jane Doe, Cobalt Grid, Lisbon** | **Meets all:** 6 yrs; Spark yes, Kafka yes, Airflow yes; streaming yes — talk on “Streaming smart-meter data at 2M events/sec”. Nice: dbt yes, utilities yes. | EU auth to confirm; openness to move not stated (no opt-out). | **contact now** | Full must-have + both nice-to-haves + Lisbon + energy domain. Best fit. |
| 2 | **Richard Miles, ex-Helio Power, Lisbon** | **Meets all:** 7 yrs prior; Spark yes, Kafka yes, Airflow yes; streaming likely — Kafka/Spark/Airflow pipelines for solar telemetry; Flink course just completed. Nice: energy yes. Open to work: yes. | Recency after 2023-2025 caregiving break — assess by technical screen, not filter. Confirm Flink / scale. Confirm EU auth. | **contact now** | Strong technical + domain fit, available, Lisbon-based. Break is not a skills signal. |
| — | **Richard Roe, Brightlane Mobility, Porto** | Partial: 8 yrs; Airflow yes, some Kafka; **No Spark/Flink, no proven prod. streaming.** | Porto to Lisbon 2d/week hybrid difficult, though remote-within-Portugal possible. | **do not contact** | **Active-client 12-month non-solicitation** covers Brightlane employees. Breach risk + weak core fit. Alert agency legal, do not approach. |
| — | **John Doe, Orbital Freight, Lisbon** | Partial: 5 yrs; Spark yes, Airflow yes; **No Kafka, no streaming evidenced.** | Headline: “Not looking. Please, no recruiter messages.” | **do not contact** | Respect explicit opt-out. Do not message. Also incomplete Kafka/streaming fit. |
| — | **John Stiles, Verdant Labs, Berlin** | Strong technically: 12 yrs; Spark/Flink/Kafka yes; streaming to confirm; orchestrator unclear. | **Location block:** “Remote only, not relocating” vs. Lisbon 2d/week hybrid, remote only within Portugal. No relocation offered. | **do not contact** | Fails location requirement and stated preference. Do not pursue. |
| — | **Mary Major, Saltwind Retail, Lisbon** | **Does not meet:** 4 yrs (<5); **No Spark/Flink, Kafka, Airflow, streaming.** Only dbt/Looker/SQL. | Senior scope mismatch. | **do not contact** | Does not meet senior must-haves. Keep only for future Analytics roles with consent, not this search. |

Assessment is skills- and requirements-based only. Age and career breaks were not used as filters.

## 2. First-touch emails

Only 2 candidates meet lawful, contractual and consent criteria for this role. No third email is sent to avoid breaching non-solicitation, opt-outs, or location preferences.

### Email 1 — Jane Doe
**Subject:** Lisbon Senior Data Engineer — smart-meter streaming at Groundswell?

> Hi Jane,
>
> Saw your Cobalt Grid talk on streaming smart-meter data at 2M events/sec — directly relevant to Groundswell Energy, where we forecast grid demand from smart-meter data.
>
> We're hiring Senior Data Engineer (Spark/Kafka/Airflow, Lisbon hybrid 2 days/week, remote within Portugal only, €70-85k + equity, EU auth required).
>
> Open to a 20-min chat next week?
>
> Best, [Name] | [Agency] | [phone] — happy to not follow up if not relevant.

*78 words*

### Email 2 — Richard Miles
**Subject:** Your Helio Power telemetry work — Senior Data Engineer, Lisbon?

> Hi Richard,
>
> Your 7 years building Kafka/Spark/Airflow pipelines for solar telemetry at Helio Power stands out for Groundswell’s grid-demand forecasting, plus your recent Flink course.
>
> We're hiring Senior Data Engineer, Lisbon hybrid 2 days/week (remote within Portugal only), €70-85k + equity, EU auth required.
>
> Would you be open to a 20-min intro next week?
>
> Best, [Name] | [Agency] | [phone] — happy to not follow up if not relevant.

*70 words*

## 3. Follow-up template (5 working days later)

**Subject:** Re: [original subject]

> Hi [First name], just bumping my note on the Groundswell Senior Data Engineer role — Lisbon hybrid 2d/week, €70-85k + equity. Worth a brief chat, or should I close this? Thanks, [Name]

*32 words*

## 4. Reply to CTO

> Hi [Name], thanks for the steer on hunger — I’ll screen for drive via impact and on-call streaming ownership.
>
> I can’t apply under-35 / “digital native” or skip-career-gaps filters: that would be age discrimination under EU/Portuguese law and would cut proven talent — e.g. my #2 fit built solar telemetry pipelines for 7 years and just upskilled on Flink.
>
> Alternative: shortlist purely on must-haves + work-sample on Kafka/Spark streaming, structured interviews. Happy to walk through the two Lisbon fits?
>
> Best, [Name]

*88 words*
